coder_notes: Only investigational product is CAR-NK cell therapy (excluded type), so the trial has no candidate; cyclophosphamide and fludarabine are conditioning (supportive, R6). Antigen biomarkers are entry requirements and define cohorts, but candidate_matched is false because no candidate agent exists (the CAR constructs do target these antigens). The brief summary describes itself as a 'draft, ClinicalTrials.gov-style example record'. Lead sponsor 'Beijing Biotech' taken as industry. The catheter/reservoir device is not listed.
